title: Kununu Salary by Job Title Scraper
description: Get Kununu salary statistics by job title and country, including average pay, ranges, city comparisons, experience groups, and related roles. Batch titles for research.

batch.title: Job titles
batch.description: Job titles whose Kununu salary statistics you want to retrieve.
batch.valueDescription: Job Title used to run this search.

schema.description: Kununu country market code, such as de, at, or ch. Accepted values: de, at, ch.
Job title to resolve to the closest available Kununu salary profile.

data.caveat: Salary values are estimates based on available reports.

storeCopy.seoTitle: Kununu Salary | Salary by Job Title
storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Kununu salary data by job title and country. Export salary ranges, averages, city comparisons, experience groups, and related roles for research.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve Kununu salary statistics by job title and country, including pay ranges, averages, city comparisons, experience groups, and related roles. Batch titles in one run.
useCases: Job seekers can compare reported salary ranges for a target role.
Compensation teams can review pay differences across cities and experience groups.
Labor-market analysts can compare related jobs and salary distributions.
howToUse: Add a job title to each entry in `job_titles`.
Choose Germany, Austria, or Switzerland for the salary market.
Review the matched title and salary statistics in the returned object.

faqs.question: What if Kununu matches a different job title?
faqs.answer: The response includes the resolved title and may include alternatives so you can confirm which statistics were selected.

fields.name: success
fields.description: True when Kununu returned salary statistics for the requested title.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Resolved job-title statistics, salary ranges, city and experience comparisons, and related roles.

fields.name: meta
fields.description: Resolved title, alternatives, fetch timing, and cache status.

fields.name: input_job_title
fields.description: Job title submitted for the Kununu salary lookup.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this record was collected.
